title: Fertilizer GKG share z>1.5 -> CF abs return lag3
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] REVERSAL: GDELT fertilizer GKG share 20d z-score > 1.5 leads CF absolute returns (volatility) by 3 days (+); trade long CF straddle-proxy 5d [gdelt.gkg.fertilizer_share -> finance.CF.abs_return] (parent: R2-0039)
message: Supported weakly (r=0.22, n=390, best lag -6d r=0.29) but validity 0; trade hit-rate 1.0 is an abs-return artifact, not a real edge

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.fertilizer_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long CF next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] NULL CONTROL: the R2-0138 CF abs-return "hit rate 1.0" is an artifact of an always-positive target; test whether GDELT fertilizer GKG share 20d z-score > 1.5 predicts the SIGNED CF log return at lag 3 (expect ~0); trade long CF 5d only if hit rate > 0.55 [gdelt.gkg.fertilizer_share -> finance.CF.log_return] (parent: R2-0138)
